item.title: 一项诊断管理倡议以改善癌症患者中诺如病毒感染和硝唑尼特的使用
item.description: 摘要 患者和医疗工作者面临诺如病毒感染的风险。硝唑尼特常被使用,但缺乏相关数据。多重聚合酶链反应平台可能导致假阳性结果。一项质量改进倡议导致硝唑尼特使用量减少了84.4%,并实现了显著的成本节约,而不会影响患者护理或医院内感染率。

item.title: 2011年至2025年中国昆明市其他传染病性腹泻的时空动态及病原谱分析
使用AsCas12f-拆分G-四联体传感器对叶类蔬菜中的食源性病毒进行可视化检测。
item.description: 摘要 食源性病毒在全球范围内导致了显著的疾病负担,其中新鲜农产品是传播病毒传播的主要媒介。然而,对于固体农产品(如叶类蔬菜)的快速检测仍处于发展阶段,因为传统方法通常需要繁琐的样品制备和专门的仪器。本文中,我们提出了一种基于颜色变化的CRISPR-拆分G4生物传感器,用于叶类蔬菜中监测病毒的快速检测,该传感器结合了逆转录重组酶聚合酶扩增(RT-RPA)、AsCas12f介导的转切割作用以及模块化的拆分G-四联体(split-G4)报告系统。在该系统中,目标识别激活了AsCas12f的转切割活性,导致阻断链的降解,并随后组装出具有催化活性的G4-血红素DNA酶,从而产生肉眼可见的信号。以诺如病毒作为模型病原体,该平台表现出高分析灵敏度和特异性,能够在最少仪器条件下可靠地检测病毒颗粒。为了评估实际应用性,该检测方法与简化后的叶盘提取流程相结合,并成功应用于未经过病毒核酸纯化的受污染生菜和婴儿菠菜样本。该平台在生菜和菠菜组织中分别实现了每100毫克1000和5000个病毒拷贝的检测限。从样品处理到肉眼读数,整个检测过程大约需要2小时。通过将等温扩增、基于CRISPR的目标识别以及无需仪器的信号生成整合到一个优化的工作流程中,该策略为分散式食品安全监测提供了有前景的平台,并为在复杂食品基质中现场检测病毒病原体建立了一个灵活的框架。

item.title: FDA批准更新的bioMérieux胃肠病原体检测面板,采用重新设计的诺如病毒检测方法 - 临床实验室产品
item.description: FDA批准了更新的bioMérieux胃肠病原体检测面板,采用重新设计的诺如病毒检测方法,以增强对胃肠感染的诊断能力。该更新由Clinical Lab Products于2026年11月9日报道,自2026年11月2日起生效,旨在提高对人类诺如病毒的检测准确性和效率。此次变更并不表示出现了新的暴发病例或情况,而是反映了诊断技术的进步。该事件被确认为监管批准,且在此上下文中未报告与诺如病毒相关的病例、死亡或暴露事件。此次更新是更大范围努力的一部分,旨在改进传染病诊断工具,包括诺如病毒引起的胃肠炎,而不引入新的公共卫生风险。

item.title: Norovirus No. 1 cause of cruise ship outbreaks for past 30 years, but other pathogens gaining - CIDRAP
item.description: CIDRAP 发布于 2026 年 11 月 9 日的文章指出,诺如病毒 在过去 30 年一直是邮轮 暴发 的主要原因。然而,文章也提到其他病原体正在越来越多地导致此类 暴发。报告强调了更广泛的公共卫生问题,包括美国可能失去麻疹消除状态的潜在风险。一个国际机构目前正在评估麻疹再次成为地方病的证据。尽管 诺如病毒 仍然是一个重要问题,但文章还提及其他健康威胁,例如耐药性感染和牙科手术的长期影响。该文章提醒人们重视 疫苗接种 和公共卫生准备,特别是对儿童和免疫力低下成人等易感人群。这些发现基于 CIDRAP 的分析,并是关于传染病趋势和应对措施的更大讨论的一部分。

item.title: Moderna’s norovirus vaccine plans in limbo in wake of phase 3 miss
item.description: Moderna has paused its plans to enroll a new cohort in the phase 3 trial of its norovirus vaccine, mRNA-1403, following an interim analysis miss in July 2024. The trial, launched in September 2024 in the Northern Hemisphere, was intended to prevent acute gastroenteritis caused by human norovirus. Instead of proceeding with the trial this winter, the company will meet with regulators to decide on future actions. Moderna's President, Stephen Hoge, stated that the decision was based on a review of the program and that further updates will be provided after these discussions. The vaccine's development has faced challenges, including an FDA hold in February 2025 due to a reported case of Guillain-Barré syndrome. While the company has a clearer path for its personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, the norovirus vaccine's progress remains uncertain. The company also noted a 27% drop in R&D expenses in the third quarter, attributed to the wind-down of certain late-stage studies.

item.title: 澳大利亚多人感染270例病毒 - 食品安全新闻
item.description: 根据食品安全新闻的报道,澳大利亚出现了多起诺如病毒 暴发疫情,两周内导致超过270人患病。这些暴发与患病员工继续工作有关,这加剧了病毒的传播。尽管报告强调了这些暴发的影响,但并未提供关于调查、检测或控制措施的具体细节。报告的重点在于食品安全,暗示了这些暴发可能与食品处理实践有关。报告中没有明确提及风险等级,但疫情规模表明存在显著的公共卫生问题。报告未具体说明暴发的确切数量或持续时间,仅提到两周的时间范围。

item.title: FDA批准更新的bioMérieux GI面板,采用重新设计的诺如病毒 GI/GII检测方法
item.description: FDA于2026年11月9日批准了更新的bioMérieux GI面板,采用重新设计的诺如病毒 GI/GII检测方法。这些面板旨在通过使用单个粪便样本检测22种常见的病原体,提高对胃肠感染的诊断特异性,包括诺如病毒。新版本的面板适用于BIOFIRE FILMARRAY 2.0和TORCH系统,结果可在约一小时内获得。GI1.1面板将全球部署,而GI1.1面板Mid则首先在美国推出。这些更改基于上市后的监测和研发进展,公司声称这些更新将支持更好的临床决策和感染控制工作。这些面板对于诊断诺如病毒胃肠炎具有重要意义,该病是急性胃肠炎的重要原因之一,尤其是在易感人群如婴幼儿、老年人和免疫功能低下者中。

item.title: 诺如病毒胃肠炎在冬季在婴儿和幼儿中传播:母乳喂养和补水情况如何? - 体育朝鲜
item.description: The article, published on 2026-11-06 by Sportschosun, highlights the spread of norovirus gastroenteritis among infants and young children during winter. According to surveillance data from the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency, norovirus infections began increasing in the first week of November 2025, with 617 weekly cases recorded in the third week of January 2026. Infants and children aged 0 to 6 years accounted for 51.1% of all cases, underscoring the need for vigilance in group settings like daycare centers. The primary concern is dehydration, which can develop rapidly in young children due to repeated vomiting and diarrhea. The article advises continued breastfeeding, frequent small amounts of oral rehydration solution, and thorough handwashing to prevent infection. It also recommends cleaning contaminated areas and keeping children home for 48 hours after symptoms subside. If a child shows signs of severe dehydration, such as reduced urine output or lethargy, prompt medical care is essential.

item.title: 关键事实:前景向好;诺如病毒 未达预期;mFLUSIVA 获批,黑色素瘤数据积极 - TradingView
item.description: 来自TradingView的新闻报道,日期为2026-11-07,讨论了Moderna的Phase 3 诺如病毒 疫苗试验未能达到中期成功标准。因此,公司决定本季不再招募队列研究参与者,并将与卫生官员商讨下一步行动。报道还提到,Moderna将2026年的收入增长指引上调至15%–25%。然而,该内容仅为部分转载摘要,无法提取完整原文。报道未提供与诺如病毒 疫苗试验相关的具体病例、死亡或暴露数量,也未提及任何明确的风险等级。信息基于三个来源,研究结果仅限于试验结果和公司的回应。

item.title: BIOFIRE FILMARRAY GI1.1 面板获得FDA清关用于肠道病原体检测 - SelectScience
item.description: On 9 November 2026, bioMérieux announced the FDA 510(k) clearance for the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® GI1.1 Panel and GI1.1 Panel Mid, which are designed to detect 22 and 11 gastrointestinal pathogens, respectively, from a single stool sample. These panels include a redesigned norovirus GI/GII assay and improved Campylobacter detection, enhancing specificity and reliability. The GI1.1 Panel also received IVDR CE marking for European commercialization, while the Panel Mid will initially be available in the United States. Norovirus, a major cause of acute gastroenteritis, is particularly prevalent among young children, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals, causing an estimated 1.7 billion cases globally each year. The panels aim to support timely clinical decision-making and improve infection control efforts by providing rapid and accurate diagnostic results. bioMérieux emphasized that these enhancements are part of its commitment to developing high-quality diagnostic solutions and continuously improving existing technologies.

item.title: Vaxart Inc(场外交易代码:VXRT)股价、VXRT 股票新闻、VXRT 股价和更新 - kalkine.ca
item.description: Vaxart Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology firm based in South San Francisco, announced that its oral bivalent vaccine targeting the GI.1 and GII.4 strains of human norovirus is currently in Phase 2 clinical trials. The information, posted on the financial‐data site kalkine.ca on November 6, 2026, does not include any efficacy or safety results, nor does it report any cases or deaths related to norovirus. As a development-stage product, the vaccine remains under investigation, and its public‐health impact is not yet known. The company’s pipeline update highlights ongoing research but leaves key questions about the vaccine’s performance and risk profile unanswered.

item.title: BioMérieux获得FDA批准其修订版BioFire胃肠检测试剂盒 - Idéal Investisseur
item.description: 2026年11月9日,BioMérieux获得了其修订版BioFire胃肠检测试剂盒的FDA批准,该试剂盒包括针对诺如病毒 GI/GII的更新测试和优化的检测沙门氏菌的算法。这些试剂盒旨在提高诊断的特异性与可靠性,以应对非特异性胃肠炎症状的诊断挑战。GI1.1试剂盒将全球推广,而Mid变种主要在美国销售。公司强调这些更新对于支持感染控制和临床决策的重要性。诺如病毒是急性胃肠炎的主要原因之一,其在社区和医疗机构中传播迅速。此次批准是BioMérieux持续致力于通过上市后的监测和研发改进诊断技术的一部分。未报告具体病例或死亡人数,但该事件突显了先进检测技术在管理胃肠疾病中的作用。
